$comment: Same-region budgets from cloudflare/performance.md §2 (cutover gates). Times are p50/p95 in ms; first_load_kb is a maximum in KB (1000 bytes) actually sent (accept-encoding gzip, br). file_read uses the cold note-open budget (a REST read goes to the store, like a cold open). The web client opens notes on its workspace socket (protocol v2): ws_connect (once per workspace per tab) carries the new-WebSocket note-open budget, open_v2_* the note switch; open_cold/open_warm are v1 (a socket per note, the Mac app until it moves to v2).

open_v2_cold.label: note open on the socket (v2), cold

open_v2_warm.label: note open on the socket (v2), warm
